headline: Head of the State Tax Service admits tax control has a minor impact on inflation
summary: The head of Kyrgyzstan's State Tax Service said tax administration and bringing business out of the shadow economy had a minor impact on inflation in the country.
why: Tax enforcement and informal-sector formalization can affect reported prices and government revenue, which matter for macro policy in emerging economies.
original_headline: Глава ГНС признал незначительное влияние налогового контроля на инфляцию
